purpose: same prompt, different solver models: the bare DSPy docstring instructions of cand-019 (cnd-07aed88fb71c) run by ten current small-tier models through OpenRouter
selection: one model per vendor, released Oct 2025 or later, $0.07-1.00 per M input tokens; llama-4-maverick and claude-3-haiku rejected for age; qwen/qwen3.8-flash withdrawn 2026-09-08 (provider unreachable), leaving nine models

withdrawn.why: its OpenRouter provider returned 'Provider returned error' persistently across four launches on 2026-09-07/08, surviving backoff of up to 7.5 minutes, and it also emits unparseable JSON deterministically on 14 hover tasks. It ended three capture runs before the runner learned to skip it.
withdrawn.traces_kept: left on disk under models-1-* and excluded from the set; not deleted

membership_note: candidate_ids is the full ordered membership and never changes: a candidate's index in this list is its identity in every capture directory (candidate_004/...), so removing one would renumber the models after it and mis-associate traces already on disk. Withdrawn candidates keep their slot and are listed in 'withdrawn'; runners and analyses read 'active_candidate_ids'.
